body.name: resGenH
body.def: From an input and residual payload, the projection generator enumerates the circuits produced by every displayed finite elimination order. The contrast generator enumerates the fixed signed canonical response-row swaps and their finite tensor products, forms their rational observation-map matrices, and applies deterministic rational row reduction in encoded order to enumerate affine nullspace contrasts and rational sign boxes. Neither generator receives a desired formula, contrast, or successful trace.
